title: Developing Lattice Matched ZnMgSe Shells on InZnP Quantum Dots for Phosphor Applications

source_inventory.title: Developing Lattice Matched ZnMgSe Shells on InZnP Quantum Dots for Phosphor Applications
source_inventory.scope: The author and independent auditor each read all nine main and eight SI pages as text and original-page images: InZnP core and ZnMgSe/ZnS preparations, four distinct source sample families, Mg feed versus measured ratios, reference bulk data, failed controls, scale-up and characterization. External cited full recipes and unprinted curve values are excluded.
source_conflicts: Protective ZnS paragraph starts 30 min after the last ZnMgSe injection although this preceding paragraph describes bare-NC workup. The exact location of workup relative to shelling is not silently resolved.
Methods begins injection at 50 C while heating toward 200 C; Results describes addition at 200 C. No assumed thermal profile reconciles these statements.
Main5 prose summarizes Mg:Zn up to approximately30% at75%feed; Figure3f separately prints ICP0.35 and XPS0.29. Approximate prose is retained without replacing either ratio.
Figure4c caption references samples measured in Figure3a; retained as source cross-reference inconsistency rather than an exact Figure3 TEM batch join.
Source In:Zn6:1 muchlowerthan2:1 wording is inconsistent; exact numerical ratios retained.
limitations: No inferred physical batch identity among source-associated samples.
No raw curve digitization, measured atomic coordinates or training eligibility.
Main source prints CC-BY-NC-ND; unchanged attributed crops retain source license limitations.
